questions_for_hospital: Can you confirm the patient will arrive at our site before 18:00 on 05/26, so the 05/25 18:00 COVID test is still within 24 hours?
Is the patient on any isolation precautions?
Does the patient have any history of conservatorship or a Full Service Partnership (FSP)?
Has the patient had any auditory or visual hallucinations?
Will the patient arrive with a 30-day supply of her self-administered medications, or is hospice supplying all of them?
Could the referral form be corrected to show Hospice: Yes (Sunrise Hospice)?

claude_fit.reason: EOL-1 is met (hospice arranged with a confirmed site visit and med-administration education documented), and she meets ADL-1, MOB-3, COG-1/COG-2 and INF-1/INF-2. Remaining gaps are minor unknowns (MH-3, MH-5, OTH-4) and the form's wrong hospice box, which the chart overrides.
